messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #17345 (feature/branchgate) is stuck in the merge queue. One smoke job keeps failing intermittently: `render-smoke`. Looks nondet. Can someone take a quick look? @michael @sarah

michael: On it. Which CI run/link?

alex: https://ci.internal/runs/17345 — the failing step is `render-smoke` on macos-compact. Fails about 1/8 runs for me.

sarah: I can pull the snapshot diff but if it's nondet we shouldn't update snapshots blindly. Did you try a looping local run?

alex: Ran loop 20x locally, failed twice. Last failing tail:
```
AssertionError: canvas pixel mismatch at (432, 210)
expected #ffffff but got #fefefe
stack: RenderEngine.draw -> SnapshotAssert.compare
```

michael: Thanks. I'll queue a rerun first to see if it's transient. If rerun is green we can fast-track; if it flakes again we should isolate the test or add a retry wrapper.

tina: @michael rerun queued: https://ci.internal/runs/17345/retry/2 — tagging oncall in case infra noise.

ci-bot: Build 1758123456.2 started by michael.

michael: Rerun came back ✅ all green. Still uneasy — the pixel diff is a 1px anti-aliasing wobble. Suspect timing on font rendering. I'll open a tiny PR to add a deterministic font fallback in the test harness (should be safe). Plan: small change + smoke run, request fast-track.

sarah: Sounds good. If michael's quick PR stabilizes CI we can merge. If not, let's mark the test flaky in tracking and skip during merge window. @alex do you want me to merge if the harness PR passes?

alex: Please hold off for ~20m — I reproduced locally and have a minimal repro fix that avoids the wobble by pinning rendering scale. I'll push shortly. Thanks for the quick rerun everyone :raised_hands:

ci-bot: Build 1758123456.2 finished — all passed.

michael: Thanks — I'll keep an eye on the merge queue and fast-track once alex's patch is up. :thumbsup:
